page_title: Big Data - Nathan Marz and James Warren

sources.entry: Big Data: Principles and best practices of scalable realtime data systems by Nathan Marz and James Warren

summary.name: Big Data (Manning book)
summary.one_liner: A book by Nathan Marz and James Warren that teaches how to build scalable big data systems using the Lambda Architecture, with tools such as Hadoop, Storm, and NoSQL databases.
use_cases: learning how to design big data systems
building real-time analytics on web-scale data
streamlining a batch and near-real-time data pipeline
deploying and operating big data systems
extending traditional database skills to NoSQL and clustered storage
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a Manning book that teaches how to build big data systems using clustered hardware and new tools for capturing and analyzing web-scale data. It presents the Lambda Architecture as a scalable approach that a small team can build and run. The book covers big data theory, practical implementation, and how to deploy and operate systems. It names specific technologies including Hadoop, Storm, Cassandra, and NoSQL databases. It requires no prior large-scale data analysis or NoSQL experience, though familiarity with traditional databases helps.
notable: Presents the Lambda Architecture as a scalable approach a small team can run
Covers Hadoop, Storm, Cassandra and NoSQL databases
Written by Nathan Marz, originator of the Lambda Architecture, per reviewer blurb
caveats: Book is sold through Manning; the page's pricing is for a Manning subscription plan ($49.99 monthly or $499.99 annually), not the book alone
Book content is tied to the specific tools named (Hadoop, Storm, Cassandra) which may have changed since publication
